observed: Result: Passed, tested on the QA branch by recording what each test user's visits sent to Google Analytics, and working out the week's figures with the PRD's own rules (distinct users; one person counts once; the whole week, not an average of days).
Day 1 (12 Oct, Pakistan time): user 1 turned VIN/Serial on and off several times and ended with it on.

Day 2 (13 Oct, just after midnight Pakistan time, as you chose): user 2 turned VIN/Serial on; user 3 turned Total price off; user 4, who cannot see financial data, only opened Board View and was never offered Total price.
VIN/Serial: 4 users saw it and 2 have it on, so 2 of 4 = 50%, exactly as expected (not the 66.7% an average of the two days would give).
Total price: only the 3 users who can see financial data count, and 2 have it on, so 2 of 3 = 66.7%, exactly as expected.
Each user kept the same user id on both days. The setting that hid financial data from user 4 was put back afterwards.
ShopView has no report screen for this: the report page itself is built by Milos in Google Analytics, outside ShopView, and was not looked at.
